name: Sizzlipede
description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

moves.name: Ember
moves.description: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Smokescreen
moves.description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target’s accuracy.

moves.name: Wrap
moves.description: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Flame Wheel
moves.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Coil
moves.description: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

moves.name: Slam
moves.description: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.description: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Fire Lash
moves.description: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Lunge
moves.description: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Burn Up
moves.description: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.description: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.

moves.name: Leech Life
moves.description: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Power Whip
moves.description: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move’s power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Scald
moves.description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Heat Crash
moves.description: The user slams its target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Brutal Swing
moves.description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

moves.name: Skitter Smack
moves.description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Scorching Sands
moves.description: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes more powerful each time it hits.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description: The user slaps down the target’s held item, and that item can’t be used in that battle. The move does more damage if the target has a held item.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.description: While resisting, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. This lowers the Sp. Atk stats of those hit.
